prompt: What is a method reference, e.g. System.out::println?
choices: A shorthand for a lambda that calls an existing method
A reference to the method's memory address
A way to declare a method inside another method
A deprecated form of anonymous inner class
explanation: System.out::println is equivalent to the lambda 's -> System.out.println(s)'. Method references are more concise when the lambda body is just a single method call.
